skill.summary: Analyze Hong Kong listed stocks and produce prediction-ready theses from price action, fundamentals, technicals, southbound flows, AH premium, liquidity, and...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of hk-stock-predictor.
- Analyzes Hong Kong-listed stocks using price action, fundamentals, technicals, southbound flows, AH premium, liquidity, and event catalysts.
- Normalizes user input and builds structured, time-bounded, forecastable predictions.
- Integrates with multiple data sources and prioritizes skills for HK-specific context.
- Generates scenario analysis (bull/base/bear) and ranks prediction candidates.
- Outputs include a structured object and a readable summary in both Chinese and English formats.
